div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 主人：填寫日期時間、合作餐廳、人數、料理類型、酒款總預算與偏好

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 系統：六項需求有效？

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 顯示欄位錯誤，不建立訂單；由主人修正後提交

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 系統：保存訂單，進入待付服務費

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 系統：揭露模擬服務費、平台收款方及取消退款規則

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 主人已確認模擬支付服務費？

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 維持待付款；平台不能邀請，酒商不能送出提案

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 系統：獨立記錄服務費付款；示範為付平台 500 元

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 平台：人工邀請酒商甲與乙

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 各受邀酒商：編輯自己的提案與酒款、容量、瓶數、單價、費用、搭配理由及配送供貨條件

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 系統：本份提案完整且費用有效？

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 保留草稿，標示缺漏或錯誤；不算已提交

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 系統：保存該酒商已提交提案，主人可查看

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 兩家均已送出有效提案？

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 可閱讀現有提案；顯示另一家待回覆，尚不能選定

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 系統：並列兩份提案、費用收款方、總支出與後續估計支出

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 酒款超出主人預算？

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 顯示超預算提醒，仍保留提案供比較

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 主人：比較後選定唯一酒商

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 系統：保存選定條件快照，鎖定需求與兩份提案；不開放改價或重選

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 協調意向成立；等待餐廳確認安排，接圖二
